cues: Water moves towards more negative water potential, and in the xylem it is pulled, under tension.
Stomata open when potassium floods the guard cells, and A B A closes them.
The light reaction makes ATP, NADPH and oxygen from water.
The Calvin cycle spends three ATP and two NADPH per carbon dioxide; C4 plants separate the steps in space, CAM plants in time.
Aerobic respiration yields thirty to thirty-two ATP.
R Q is zero point seven for fat, one for sugar.
And five hormones, with tropisms as growth, and Mimosa as turgor.
